exercises.instruction: Read each description and make a sentence using just in time.

items.prompt: (manage / stop) I managed to stop just in time.
answers: I managed to stop just in time.

items.cue: 🌧️ You were walking home. Just after you got home, it started to rain very heavily.
answers: I got home just in time.

items.cue: 🪑 Your friend was going to sit on the chair you had just painted. You said: Don’t sit on that chair!
answers: I stopped him just in time.

items.cue: 🎬 You and a friend went to the cinema. You arrived late and thought you would miss the beginning of the film — but it began just as you sat down.
answers: We got to the cinema just in time for the beginning of the film.
We got to the cinema just in time to see the beginning of the film.

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences using at the end + the following:

parts: The players shook hands
answers: at the end of the game

parts: I get paid
answers: at the end of the month

parts: The students had a party
answers: at the end of the course

parts: Two of the runners collapsed
answers: at the end of the race

parts: I was surprised when I was offered the job
answers: at the end of the interview

exercises.instruction: Read each description and write a sentence with in the end, using the verb in brackets.

items.prompt: (sell) In the end we sold it.
answers: In the end we sold it.

items.cue: 😤 Anna got more and more fed up with her job. (resign)
answers: In the end she resigned (from her job).
She resigned (from her job) in the end.

items.cue: 📖 You tried to learn Japanese, but you found it too difficult. (give up)
answers: In the end I gave up (trying to learn Japanese / learning Japanese).
I gave up (learning Japanese) in the end.

items.cue: 🤔 You couldn’t decide whether to go to the party or not. (not / go)
answers: In the end we decided not to go (to the party).
In the end we didn’t go (to the party).
We decided not to go (to the party) in the end.
We didn’t go (to the party) in the end.
